gaps: P0: nothing; P5: nothing of Halle (#16 is Basel, #17 an aircraft hangar); P6: no view of the historic center
notes: #2’s file name says 1576, but the plate (‘Hall in Sachsen’, paired with Hildesheim on the sheet, see #1) is in Civitates vol. 5, so dated 1598 per the rules. #7 is a small vignette (about 1,400 px wide after trimming) but the only 18th-century view. #9 (Battle of Halle, painted 1821) skipped: event scene, low resolution, church in background not clearly Halle’s. #8 is Paris, #10 Berlin, #12 Bad Suderode. #21 (2025, Halle-Neustadt high-rises with the city far behind) is a possible P6 fallback but shows no landmarks.
